answer: In a market where AI agents buy willow cuttings, hollow logs, and lantern parts, each seller identity must lock a refundable bond before accepting orders. Escrow releases payment after delivery, and a verified failure forfeits the bond. Creating names is free, but operating each fake seller ties up fresh capital; abandoning one after a fraudulent sale burns its bond. Setting the bond above the maximum unpaid order value makes repeated fraud unprofitable.
